name: CE_PARSING_RULES
description: CE_PARSING_RULES Contains information about parsing rules.

columns.name: PARSING_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identification of the parsing rule.

columns.name: PARSING_RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Identification of the parent parsing rule set.

columns.name: TRX_CODE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the bank transaction code.

columns.name: PARSE_RULE
columns.description: Parse rule to be used for extracting data from a source field.

columns.name: SOURCE_FIELD
columns.description: Source of the parsing rule. This information is obtained from the interface table.

columns.name: TARGET_FIELD
columns.description: Source of the parsing rule. This information is obtained from the functional  table.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: A yes or no flag to indicate whether the rule is active.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Number assigned to a parsing rule that determines the priority of the rule.

columns.name: OVERWRITE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the target field can be overwrriten.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
